setting: You are all neighbours in a street in Leeds, England, and you know each other from living close by, saying hello over garden walls, sharing bins and a shared driveway, and chatting on the pavement.
openers: Ask if anyone's bins were collected
Share a photo of a frosty car windscreen
Warn about the parking on Tuesday

Nadia.knows: You know Keith as the older man two doors down whom you've chatted with for years, and Connor as the young man who lives across the road, whom you've nodded to and talked with over the years.
Nadia.texts: Nadia texts in this chat now and then.
Nadia.style: uses a little emoji and some texting abbreviations.

Keith.knows: You know Nadia as the planner who lives a few doors along, and Connor as the young lad across the road you've talked to over the years.
Keith.texts: Keith texts in this chat now and then.
Keith.style: uses almost no emoji and no texting abbreviations.

Connor.work: sound engineer at a gig venue
Connor.knows: You know Nadia as the council planner next door-ish across the way, and Keith as the older taxi driver two doors down you've chatted with.
Connor.texts: Connor texts in this chat a lot.
Connor.style: uses some emoji and plenty of texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Nadia: You live in Leeds, work as a council planner, and live alone.
private_lines.Keith: You live in Leeds, spend your days semi-retired from driving a taxi, and live alone.
private_lines.Connor: You live in Leeds, work nights at a gig venue as a sound engineer, and live alone.

text: Anyone need a ladder? Got the long one in the shed, not using it till spring 🪜
What size
The 3 section one. Goes up to about 7m
Might be useful. Back gutter's coming away from the wall
Oh no. Do you need it today
Not today. Weekend maybe. If you're sure
Yeah totally. Shed's never locked, just take it
ladder?? i need one for the bulbs over the door. been meaning to sort it since august lol
Two people on that ladder is not safe. Get someone to foot it
i will get someone to foot it
Take it whenever! I'm in all weekend
can i grab it tmrw after i get up? like 5ish
I'm back from the rank by 4 tomorrow. I'll give you a hand with the gutter if you want, bring the ladder round to mine first
That works. Don't let connor fall off it keith
He won't fall. He's too young to fall
Ladder's round the side by the bins not in the shed. Sorry forgot to say. It's lying on the wall
up. ladder still there?
nvm i can see it from my window lol
Just pulled in. It's still there. I'll bring it round to mine when I've put the car away
cant do 5 now, load in at the academy is 6. can i come at 5:30 instead
5:30 is fine. Gutter's been hanging since August, it'll keep
thats what i said about the bulbs
Home. I can hold the ladder if u need a 3rd
We're fine
i'll foot it keith
You'll foot it and stay on the bottom rung
Ok be careful both of u
Gutter's back up. Ladder's back by the bins. Don't ask how long it took
[photo: gutter with a bit of gaffer tape on the join]
that's the hard bit btw
Thank u both!! Tell keith he's a legend
Gonna pass out. Night x
Morning. Gutter's looking good from the front keith 👍
Cheers. Stiff as a board this morning
Connor did you get the bulbs done
no. got up 40 mins ago lol. bulbs are still a thing
will do them sunday if its dry
Get Nadia to foot it. She's got more sense
Ha I'm not footing anything I'll hold the kettle
kettle counts
Rain's coming in from the west around 9. Gutter's only just on, don't go climbing in it
on at the academy tonight. out till like 2. could someone let the wheelie bin out for tmrw? its my turn
I'll do it
ta
Bins are out
load out done. dead. night
